comments_text: Mechanism: The peptide inhibits Mpro, a protein crucial for viral replication.
cytotoxicity_text: No cytotoxicity information or data found in the reference(s) presented in this entry
hemolytic_activity_text: [Ref.35896605]BRIP is not hemolytic at 500 nM and slightly hemolytic at 50 µM.
title: A ricin-based peptide BRIP from Hordeum vulgare inhibits Mpro of SARS-CoV-2
